prose: For this month's Marvel movie, our heroes scrutinize the sorcerer supreme, exploring the 2016 film "Dr. Strange." What does the master of the mystic arts have in common with the "Great Beast" Aleister Crowley? What's up with this multiverse meme that seems to be everywhere right now? And what occulted truths about the fractal of life are casually planted throughout this psychedelic screenplay?
music: Intro music, "The Balance" by Wisdom Traders
